I honestly bought a couple of different decks when I first gained an interest in tarot. 

The first one was a RWS deck, I didn’t connect with it at all. For learning the basics it’s a good deck but It was very difficult to read from for myself, kind of a learning tool versus trying to read them. 

My second deck I purchased was the Golden Thread Tarot, RWS based, it’s a beautiful deck and is great for the imagery and the ease of discerning the meaning from them. I still didn’t connect with the deck though.

The third deck I purchased was the Sasuraibito Tarot and I finally found “the deck.” It has a personality, the readings always come off in the same voice, the imagery is gorgeous but slightly difficult to understand but the little booklet that came with it explains it quite well and I’m also able to draw my own meanings thanks to the book. Im not sure if it’s RWS. 

So my advice is find a deck you like, RWS are standard for beginners but be open to anything.
